question: Perihelion is when Earth is ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**nearest to the sun**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Perihelion** is the point in the orbit of a planet, asteroid, or comet at which it is closest to the sun.
 
• For Earth, perihelion occurs around January 3rd each year.
 
• During perihelion, Earth is about 147.1 million kilomete
